reference_adapter: new_reference_v2; exact JSON theorem certified with a fresh unique declaration
representative_selection: Choose lowest SHA256([seed,exercise_group,trace_id]) among all reliably localized evaluation failures before error-position filtering; a missing formal-entry boundary excludes that representative without substitution.
technical_pilot_gate: Complete fixed attempts with exact saved original token reconstruction and finite aligned log probabilities; at least one extractable matching theorem declaration. No semantic correctness gate.
fixed_maxima: All observed source positions including absorbing unreached suffix; exclude first increment only for the DeepSeek primary later-error positional test. D0 primary; other offsets descriptive.
analysis_unit: Equal exercise groups: attempt average within problem, then problem average within group. DeepSeek uses one trace per group.
first_increment_note: Formal-entry X0 differs from original paper prompt X0; this is a prospectively declared measurement variant.
infrastructure_retry: Only checkpoint continuation after TIMEOUT/NODE_FAIL/PREEMPTED, at most two retries; no silent retry of semantic or integrity failures.
